description: We are a group of FIRST Robotics Team 1710 members who are interested in programming, data analysis, and building quality software. We have a combined 20+ years of experience writing code, but have never attempted a hackathon before as a team.
summary: This web app queries and displays images from NASA's SPHEREx space telescope to allow users to find moving objects.
details:
Viewing astronomical data is difficult for everyday people because of its technical complexity. 

Cosmic Viewport solves this problem by creating a website that uses SPHEREx data to allow viewers to pull up images using Right Ascension and declination. These coordinates are easy for people to find with a simple google search of the coordinates for the object they want to view. 

They can look through the different wavelengths that SPHEREx uses and look at how the photos change over time and easily spot differences.

Viewport is written in pure python for both pulling NASA data and displaying it to the user.
